1.title: Educational temperature reader — TMP36 and a development board
1.scope: Alternative room-temperature demonstration. It replaces the thermistor chain with an analog TMP36 and reports readings to a computer; it is not the illustrated clinical thermometer or an LCD build.

items.purpose: Produces a temperature-dependent analog voltage.
items.purchase: Required; pin orientation must follow the guide.

items.name: Arduino Uno development board
items.purpose: Includes ADC and microcontroller; reads the sensor and sends serial measurements.
items.purchase: Required; use the guide-compatible board and code.

items.name: Solderless breadboard
items.purpose: Supports the sensor and temporary electrical connections.
items.purchase: Required for the illustrated prototype.

items.name: Breadboard jumper wires
items.purpose: Connects sensor supply, ground and analog output.
items.purchase: Required; supply, ground and A0 connections follow the guide.

items.name: Arduino Uno USB programming cable
items.purpose: Powers the board and carries firmware and serial measurements.
items.purchase: Required; connector must match the selected Uno revision.

items.name: Computer with Arduino software
items.purpose: Loads the program and shows temperature readings.
items.purchase: External equipment / software prerequisite.

items.purchase: Included in kit.

items.name: Zumo front blade and IR emitter holder

items.purchase: Included in kit; install as directed by the manufacturer.

items.name: Zumo graphical display module
items.purpose: Presents local program information and sensor feedback.
items.purchase: Included in kit.

items.name: Extended-shaft micro metal gearmotor

items.name: AA battery cell
